chunks: As for whatever is in it from Ibrāhīm ibn ʿUmar, I have narrated it from my father—may Allah be pleased with him—from Saʿd ibn ʿAbdillāh, from Yaʿqūb ibn Yazīd, from Ḥammād ibn ʿĪsā, from Ibrāhīm ibn ʿUmar al-Yamānī.

key_terms.أَبِي: My father; the author's immediate transmitter in this chain.
key_terms.إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ عُمَرَ الْيَمَانِيِّ: The narrator to whom this transmission chain leads.
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; a formal term of hadith narration.

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Ibrāhīm ibn ʿUmar in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from Ibrāhīm ibn ʿUmar al-Yamānī. It serves as a technical chain statement in hadith transmission, documenting the authority path rather than conveying a substantive legal or theological teaching.
